<tspan x="621.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Local CoralLayer class only. It overrides the imported same-name class; upstream MLP and training losses excluded.

sourceFacts: A single biasless linear score is shared by all K-1 logits, then each threshold receives its own learned bias.
Default preinitialized bias is arange(K-1,0,-1)/(K-1), here [1,.75,.5,.25]; the source does not impose a hard sorted-bias constraint after updates.
This view stops at logits. Sigmoid decoding and loss calls are outside the class.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
